name: phone
title: Phone
description: A generic modern phone in portrait: a graphite frame, a thin black bezel, a camera island and side buttons. Its screen is open, so whatever lies on the tracks below shows through it: a compound clip, a web composition such as shop-app, or a picture.

name: tablet
title: Tablet
description: A generic tablet in landscape with a graphite frame, a black bezel and a camera dot. Its 4:3 screen is open: what lies below shows through.

name: laptop
title: Laptop
description: A generic laptop seen from the front: a black lid with a camera dot over a silver deck. Its 16:9 screen is open, so a 1920x1080 compound clip or page below fills it exactly.

name: browser
title: Browser window
description: A generic light browser window with a tab, navigation buttons and an address field, without any product's marks. Its 16:9 page area is open: a website, a dashboard or a web composition below shows in it.

name: street-map
title: Night street map
description: A dark city map on a 240-pixel street grid with blocks, a park, a river and a diagonal avenue, 1920x1080. Streets run along x = 120, 360, 600, 840, 1080, 1320, 1560, 1800 and y = 90, 330, 570, 810, 1050, so on a 1920x1080 timeline a route drawn with shape.add d in those pixels follows them (for example M 360 1000 L 360 810 L 840 810 L 840 330 L 1560 330 L 1560 200). Tilt it in 3D for a map in perspective.
